criteria.requirement: Add IncrementalParser(encoding=None,*,process_namespaces=False,namespace_separator=":",disable_entities=True,process_comments=False,**handler_options) with feed(chunk) and close(). Reuse pinned SAX handler, including completed resource budgets, item callbacks and postprocessor. Support UTF8 byte boundaries and text chunks, require consistent bytes/str chunk types, finalize incomplete XML with original ExpatError, make successful close idempotent and prohibit feed after close or any parse failure. Entity declarations remain disabled by default and callback interruption propagates immediately. No threads, buffering an entire input document, or restarting after failure.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
